delta_path: median over calibration target identities of (mean_pair_ms - mean_matched_standalone_ms) / mean_kernel_count[target]; aggregate all three process repetitions within identity first
delta_model: median of the same calibration identity estimates pooled by co-model, not co-path and not target model
fitting_scope: CALIBRATION pair identities only; no coefficients learned from validation
primary_metric: MAE of slowdown mu (dimensionless), equal weight to each of six validation identities
bootstrap: 50000 pair-identity paired resamples, seed 91023; process repetitions never split; identity CI conditional on fitted calibration; process-block uncertainty sensitivity reported separately
comparison: all three signed MAE differences, two-sided 95% paired bootstrap intervals; no percent threshold
selection: Order I0, I1, I2 by ascending validation MAE (complexity breaks exact ties). A candidate is eligible only if its error-difference upper 95% confidence bound is <0 against EVERY simpler model. I0 always eligible. Select lowest-MAE eligible candidate. No tuning, extra features, additional identities or retries after results.
routing_extension: sum distinct co-model busy probability * baseline-demand-weighted co-path pressure, no same-model tax; empirical g handles own replicas
multi_model_status: unvalidated additive approximation; low confidence for 3+ busy models; no new multi-model GPU campaign in this first bounded version
9B: after 9A selection, fixed-deployment bounded routing iteration only; no candidate ranking or native runtime changes
statistical_limit: six validation identities with shared targets/co-paths; bootstrap is exploratory conditional evidence, not independent six co-models; no population-wide claim
